welcome.title: Welcome to Phoresis
welcome.text: Here your gel and blot images become numbers: lanes and bands, molecular weights, purity or a western readout. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Start with an image
steps.text: Upload gel takes a scanner file (.gel, .scn, TIFF, PNG, JPEG) and asks for its assay: what the gel is read for, purity on an SDS-PAGE or host-cell proteins on a western blot, for instance.

steps.title: Your activity in four numbers
steps.text: The gels uploaded, their analyses, the analyses still pending and the gels added in the last seven days.

steps.title: The latest gels
steps.text: The most recent images with their gel type and number of analyses. Click one to open it and start an analysis; View all opens the whole list.

steps.title: Every page, from anywhere
steps.text: The dashboard, the gel images, the analyses, the comparisons, the Gel dashboard and the list of these tours. The menu opens when the pointer is over it; the arrow at its bottom pins it open.

steps.title: Find a gel by its name
steps.text: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> searches the pages and the gel images, by file name or description, from any page.
